Build the job shop bill of material

The pair has an Approved BOM carrying both components.

Status
Walked Aug 2026
Module
Common, Procurement, Manufacturing, Warehousing
Length
19 steps
Updated
22 Oct 2026
Applies to

Task 7 of 11 in Create test items · next: Build the job shop routing

Walk it

Before you start

  • You need step 1.2 (Confirm the test design); step 1.5 (Confirm the test design).
  • Create the three items complete: all three items exist and each site row shows its intended Default Supply Source. Job Shop by Site must be Active or In Preparation in Concept Activation tcemm4600m000 — the same setting Configure the made group's Production defaults depend on.

Steps

Screen
Manufacturing➔Job Shop➔Engineering➔Bills of Material tibom3100m000

Why LN works this way. A bill of material is written against the item, per site, and cannot be used for manufacture until its revision is approved; approval and the two use indicators, for planning and for costing, are three separate actions. The material lines carry the issuing warehouse, and the revision's effective date decides whether a production order's reference date selects it.

If something goes wrong

SymptomWhat to do
The BOM header will not saveConfirm Site, Product, BOM Quantity, and Effective Date. Do not clear a proposed required value to make the save pass
The BOM stays at NewOnly Approved bills of material can be used for manufacture. Run Actions➔Approve Revision on the selected row
Use for Planning is refusedAnother BOM already holds it for this item and site — one per item and site for planning, one per product for costing

    A blank BOM header opens

  5. Set Product to the finished item

    You should see

    BAM-CHOP-PAIR is selected

    You should see

  7. Set Effective Date on or before the date of the production order you intend to run

Manufacturing➔Job Shop➔Engineering➔Bills of Material tibom3100m000

    • The BOM header will not save

      Confirm Site, Product, BOM Quantity, and Effective Date. Do not clear a proposed required value to make the save pass

    • The BOM stays at New

      Another BOM already holds it for this item and site — one per item and site for planning, one per product for costing
